title: big.bi → bi.gbi: articulatory simulation of the verbal transformation (VLAM/Maeda reproduction of arXiv:2307.02299)
description:
Python implementation and didactic material reproducing the demonstrations of Why can big.bi be changed to bi.gbi? A mathematical model of syllabification and articulatory synthesis (arXiv:2307.02299, Berthommier 2023) with the VLAM (Maeda, 7 parameters) articulatory synthesizer and the modified synthSYL syllable-graph engine (delta_o/delta_e anchoring, COEFCEN syllable chaining, dot-form big.bi, no held @).

Contains: the didactic manual (PDF), four self-contained interactive HTML demonstrations (big.bi → bi.gbi; reversible and NON-reversible U-shaped Tp sweeps ib ib ↔ bi bi; trough effect with per-VCV audio), article-format figures (Figs 1/3/4, supplement /ib/ → /bi/, locus equations, trough effect), the polar two-branch reconstruction (polar_sync), and measurement/ablation scripts (locus equations, trough-effect ablations).

Documented differences from the article's own settings: valrect = 1.10 (article: 0.75), registry /b/ radius rho_b = 1.2 for the article-format Figure 1, revised synthSYL vowel table compressing the F2(vowel) axis.
